'''Dalgeer''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], who was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Dalgeer originally worked as a corporate [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]]. However, he was unable to cope with his employers' allegiance to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], so he joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], rising to the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. When the Alliance needed a competent [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] for an outpost on located in the caverns of the [[Mount Deldarca]] [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]], Dalgeer volunteered for the assignment. The base eventually became known as [[Dalgeer's Rim]].<ref name="HS" />

==Personality and traits==
Dalgeer was energetic and outspoken. He was very willing to tell people his opinions on everything.<ref name="HS" />
